name: NUSC 3236
title: Nutritional Biochemistry and Metabolism
description: Explores the metabolism and functions of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, minerals, and vitamins, emphasizing biochemical processes like digestion, absorption, enzyme kinetics, anabolic/catabolic pathways, and energy regulation across fed/fasting states, exercise, and life stages.
requirement_description: NUSC 1165, BIOL 1107, and either CHEM 2241 or CHEM 2443.
